titleStmt.title: A synthetic example paper for testing the TEI-to-JSON parser

div.head: Introduction
div.p: Deep neural networks have transformed natural language processing in recent years. Earlier work established the foundations of sequence modeling [1]. More recent studies extended these ideas to large-scale pretraining [2]. The present paper builds on both of these lines of research to study citation behavior. We describe our method in the following section and report results afterwards. Our contribution is a reproducible pipeline for extracting citing sentences from full text.

Several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate such systems [2]. These benchmarks vary widely in size and domain coverage. We adopt a standard protocol for fair comparison. The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. We first introduce the data, then the model, and finally the evaluation. A short discussion closes the paper.
